rationale: Both AJ and Yin work in robotics, with AJ bringing deep hardware-software co-design expertise from founding Seed Physical and Yin bringing marketing and robotics background from Stealth Global Robots. intro_message: AJ Chahal, meet Yin — you're both embedded in robotics from different angles (AJ building dexterous manipulation systems, Yin marketing at a robotics company), and there's potential value in connecting hardware-software innovation with go-to-market strategy.
